PROPERTY DETAILS The Property MOVE IN CONDITION 5% Dep Paid - £17.5K Flooring Included The developer can offer part exchange - further information to be discussed directly.

DESCRIPTION From the moment you arrive, this striking home makes a lasting impression, boasting exceptional curb appeal that immediately sets it apart. However, it's only upon stepping inside that the true scale and versatility of the accommodation becomes apparent. At the heart of the home lies a beautifully designed open-plan living space, effortlessly combining the lounge, kitchen, and dining areas. This expansive and light-filled environment is perfectly suited to modern family living, offering a seamless flow that encourages both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. Whether hosting guests or enjoying quiet evenings in, this space is destined to become the social hub of the home. Complementing this is a separate utility room, thoughtfully positioned to keep household tasks discreetly tucked away from the main living areas. Upstairs, the property continues to impress with four generously sized double bedrooms, ensuring ample space for family members and guests alike. Two well-appointed bathrooms provide both convenience and comfort, helping to eliminate the morning rush. Externally, the home is equally appealing. A smart block-paved driveway provides ample off-road parking and leads to an integral garage, while to the rear, a beautifully landscaped, enclosed garden offers a private sanctuary-ideal for outdoor dining, relaxation, and family enjoyment. This is a home that perfectly balances style, space, and practicality, making it an outstanding choice for modern family living.

THE DEVELOPMENT Welcome to West Park Garden Village, an exclusive development of family homes inspired by traditional values. This site provides the perfect response to people's desires for quality, new build homes but in an environment that's healthy, sustainable and community focused. Situated on Jeremiah Drive, in the village of Darlington, this development of 2, 3, 4 bedroom homes will appeal to both first time buyers and families alike. This development features a fantastic show home, finished and decorated to the highest possible standard, showcasing exactly how life could be in your new home.

LOCAL AREA West Park Garden Village is perfectly positioned to enjoy the regions countryside and city connections. West Park certainly is a community where housing and the natural world live side by side. With a range of supermarkets and cafes right on your door step, the A1 is less than a mile away and 3 miles away from Darlington train station. West Park is the ideal location for people who need to commute for work. Within close proximity there is a range of schooling for children of all ages making this the perfect family community. Located just a stone's throw away from the stunning 30 acres West Park nature reserve, West Park Garden Village is a special place to call home.
